sources.entry: mpd - Daemon to remotely play music, stream music, handle and organize playlists. Many clients available. (Source Code, Clients) GPL-2.0 C++

summary.one_liner: Music Player Daemon (MPD) is a server-side daemon that plays music of various formats through a host's audio device and can be controlled, searched and managed remotely.
summary.what_it_does: MPD runs as a background daemon that plays audio files through the server's own audio device. It keeps an index of all available music, which can be searched and retrieved. Playback control, metadata retrieval, and playlist management can all be done remotely over the network. The README describes it as having many clients available, though it does not name them. The README is brief and points to the manual, forum, IRC, bug tracker, and protocol specification for details.
use_cases: play music on a home server
search and index a local music library
how_to_run: Read the manual for basic installation instructions (or see /usr/share/doc/mpd/html in an installed system)
notable: Daemon architecture: playback runs on the server and is controlled remotely
Indexes and searches the music library
Many third-party clients available (per awesome-selfhosted listing)
Documented protocol specification for client developers
caveats: README is brief and defers installation details to the external manual
Clients are not named in the README itself
